checks.name: The room loads one integrity-pinned controller with a restrictive no-media, no-connect CSP
The hub keeps Simran, physiological breathing and modern attention as distinct entrances
Keyboard Start reveals the first prompt and puts focus on its heading
Time never advances a prompt; Next and Back preserve the selected guide
Every prompt can be reached and Finish returns focus to Start without a completion score
The surroundings path offers contact, sight or sound without paced-breath instructions
Escape and the persistent End control both finish immediately and restore Start focus
Page hiding ends the guide, and becoming visible never silently resumes it
Page exit and a persisted history return keep the guide ended
Sources keep the guide an introduction and the Stoic reflection a philosophical prompt
The layout fits 320, 390, 820 and 1440 pixels with readable type and useful touch targets
Reduced motion preserves the manual guide and visible End control at a narrow width
A mismatched document layer cannot enable the attention controller
The guide performs no persistence or data fetch, creates no cookies and requests no external resources

limitations: Desktop Chromium with responsive viewport checks. No physical iPhone, Safari or VoiceOver acceptance.
Visibility and page-history events are synthetic. Actual device backgrounding remains unverified.
These checks establish interface behavior, not therapeutic outcomes or religious approval.
